description: in these events competitors can swim using any stroke of their choice.
a swimming stroke performed on the back with the arms lifted alternately out of the water in a backward circular motion and the legs extended and kicking.
one of the major swimming strokes, performed with the swimmer with his chest forward and facing towards to bottom of the pool.
one of the major swimming stroke styles, swum on the breast, with both arms moving simultaneously, accompanied by a dolphin kick.
a swimming race in which teams of four race consecutively.
competitive swimming races conducted over various distances (10km at the Olympics) held in rivers, lakes and oceans.
an underwater swimming sport where athletes race against each other while wearing breathing apparatus.
athletes perform synchronized dance routines to music while floating in the water.
competitive swimming races conducted in extremely cold water.
competitors are awarded points for each meter swum underwater, and for how long they stayed under water.
an ex-Olympic sport in which participants dived into the water, aiming for the longest distance while remaining motionless.
a new sport which combines running and swimming over a short sprint distance.
